description.narrative: The Schuman Security and Defence Forum will be a two-day in-person meeting at high political level held in Brussels. The Schuman Security and Defence Forum is intended to provide a venue for an international encounter among politicians, policy and opinion makers, for public diplomatic exchanges as well as an opportunity for informal gatherings. It is intended to complement existing high-level venues for strategic exchange in international security and to serve as a platform for the EU to elevate its profile in the security and defence agenda and to showcase its contribution to international peace and security. It also aims to establish a stronger sense of community with those countries which have concluded Framework Participation Agreements and which contribute to EU CSDP missions and operations.

comment.narrative: The Forum was wellattended with 420 registered participants in total. Highlevel officials from many partner countries in particular from Africa were present as well as many nongovernmental participants. In particular there was strong high level ministerial or vice ministeriallevel participation from almost all European partners from invited African partners and from several Middle East Gulf countries. Both the USA and Canada were represented by senior Ambassadors rather than senior participants from the capitals. The IndoPacific region was relatively underrepresented with only Japan represented at ViceMinisterial level while a number of other invited countries from the region did not participate at all even at ambassadorial level Vietnam Republic of Korea. This suggests a need for further engagement in order to attract high level participation in future iterations. On the whole participation from invited international and regional organisations was good although there remains room for improvement in future iterations. The role of the think tank academic nongovernmental audience was appreciated. A more significant number of participants with a stronger role in the event e.g. as panel participants could contribute to a more dynamic interaction. The presence of sponsored participants from around the world identified by EU delegations in countries from which governmental representatives were invited also offers opportunities for more active engagement and followup on the ground and for a greater multiplication and amplification of the events messages. Financial sponsoring of nonEU nongovernmental participants proved useful in ensuring stronghighquality participation.

comment.narrative: The Schuman Security and Defence Forum convened under the authority of the HRVP resulted to be a successful political event to enhance the EU needs to become a stronger and more capable actor in security and defence as set up during the Strategic Compass of March 2022. The Forum reinforced the role of EU in the security and defence cooperation with partner countries and delivered on its goal to assemble the defence community from EU MS partner countries internationalregional organisations and nongovernmental participants. As indicated in the Strategic Compass which sets out a series of policies tools and instruments to enhance and develop our relationships on the basis of the EUs interests values and priorities the Schuman Security and Defence Forum made full use of the EUs network of Delegations with the objectives of enhancing the security and defence issues more systematically in political dialogues with partners and using different measures more effectively in support of EU political and strategic priorities.

comment.narrative: The agenda of the Forum was focussing on the increasing of the ability of EU and its partner countries to anticipate deter and respond to current and fastemerging threats and challenges and safeguard the EUs interest and added value in the field of security and defence. Lessons learnt and areas in which better work in an increasingly collective and coordinated manner were discussed during the plenaries with an extensive engagement of the audience.The Schuman Security and Defence Forum was successful and delivered on its objectives in terms of messaging visibility and highlevel participation. Feedback received from participants partners EU Member States MS and nongovernmental participants has been very positive both with regards to the organisational aspects and the programmeformatcontent of the discussions. A solid communication strategy and products were designed and used successfully. The event was widely covered in Europe Asia Latin America Africa Middle East and Gulf countries as well as by international media.

A solid communication strategy and products were designed and used successfully. The event was widely covered in Europe Asia Latin America Africa Middle East and Gulf countries as well as by international media.
